title: comm-lane-allocator: deterministic comm/compute lane assignment + lazy KV prefetch + adaptive batching heuristics
author: Alicia Mendez
description: Motivation: Multi-GPU tensor-parallel workloads suffer from lane contention between collective communication and compute when a single stream/priority scheme is used. This PR introduces a deterministic comm-lane allocator that assigns ordered communication lanes (high/low priority) per-layer and per-shard, enabling overlap patterns that reduce tail latency. In parallel, a lightweight 'lazy KV prefetch' optimizer is added to the KV cache path so that warmup for common prefixes is done opportunistically on stalled lanes rather than always prefetching eagerly. Finally, an adaptive continuous-batching heuristic tunes target batch size based on recent latency percentiles and observed KV cache hit rates. Changeset summary: - runtime/tp/comm_lane_allocator.cpp/.h: new allocator that maps layers -> comm lanes, exposes a compact policy DSL (per-layer override, default ring/pairwise modes). - runtime/tp/scheduler/heuristic_scheduler.py: integrates allocator decisions into the scheduling loop; allows comm/compute gating and preemption windows. - runtime/kvcache/lazy_prefetch.cc: lazy prefetch implementation; hooks to scheduler to request prefetch when comm lanes idle. - runtime/kernel_selector/per_layer_profile.cc: per-layer kernel hints (preferred kernel, workspace) emitted by model loader and consumed by scheduler. - runtime/telemetry/metrics: added per-lane latency metrics and kv_prefetch_hit/miss counters. - tests/integration/tp_comm_lane_test.py, perf/benchmarks/tp_adaptive_batch.yaml, docs/perf/comm-lane-allocator.md. Design notes: - Deterministic allocation ensures reproducible overlap decisions across replicas; avoids nondeterministic NCCL stream races. - Lazy prefetch defers non-critical KV loads until comm lanes experience slack, preserving burst bandwidth for active tokens. - Adaptive batching keeps latency SLOs stable under load by shrinking/growing targets using EMA of p95 latency and a kv-hit-factor. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (ENG-2317) - [x] Unit tests for allocator and prefetch logic - [x] Integration tests with TP pipeline - [x] Benchmarks (local cluster, p2/8xA100) - [x] Telemetry added for rollout gating Performance results (internal perf cluster, 8xA100, batcher=continuous): - Baseline: p95 generation latency 240ms, token throughput 1.0x - This PR: p95 190ms (-21%), token throughput 1.15x (+15%) - KV prefetch reduced cold-prefix penalty from 40ms to 8ms for common prefixes - Tail improvement concentrated on long-context workloads (>2k tokens) Rollout plan: feature-flag behind runtime.feature.experimental_comm_lanes; staged canary on Dedicated pools, increase traffic to Dedicated-only models, then enable globally. Related: touches on NCCL stream ordering but avoids driver changes; complements recent NCCL tuning PRs.
